project1.title: Pulse
project1.description: A three-part audiovisual journey connected by a single beat. Sound design and composition created in Ableton Live, combining field recordings and sound synthesis. Mixed in Reaper and released in immersive 10.1 multichannel format.

project2.title: Fréquences Félines
project2.description: Fréquences Félines is a radio show where cats take the microphone to share their view of the world.

project3.title: Tout est sous contrôle
project3.description: Complete studio audio production (recording, mixing, and mastering) for the track "Tout est sous contrôle" by Madruga. An evocative acoustic piece featuring guitar, piano, cajón, and cello, composed for the environmentally themed stage production "Le point de bascule."

project4.title: Twin Sides
project4.description: A short gameplay preview of Twin Sides, a first-person puzzle game developed with Cularo Games for Brackeys Game Jam 2026.1.

project5.title: Tales of Yro
project5.description: The main menu theme for Tales of Yro, a video game currently in development. The original score and arrangement were created for an academic project in collaboration with the Studio M team.

project6.title: DeadHand
project6.description: Original score and main theme for the video game DeadHand, composed entirely in just 48 hours for the Global Game Jam. A fast-paced, impactful composition designed to capture the essence and rhythm of the game.

about.title: About Me
about.description1: As a teenager, electronic music opened the door to an unexplored universe. I started out as a DJ, spending hours studying song structures, groove, and the impact of sound on people. Before long, playing other people's music was no longer enough: I felt the need to create. I realized that sound is more than music; it's a powerful storytelling tool that can make any visual or interactive experience memorable. That realization led me to turn my passion into a career and to invest independently and determinedly in my professional training.
about.description2: I've worked on a wide range of projects, from independent video games and studio music productions to live concerts and music for visual media. My approach combines creative sensitivity with close collaboration with development teams to create immersive sound experiences that amplify the emotional and narrative impact of each work. Through sonic exploration, attention to detail, and experimentation, I strive to give every project a distinctive sound identity that leaves a lasting impression.
about.description3: I work across every stage of audio production, from music composition and recording to sound design and post-production. I experiment with a range of tools and techniques to find the solution that best fits each project's identity. Whether I'm creating an atmosphere, shaping the character of a sound, or refining the final mix, I focus on every detail to stay true to the creative vision and needs of the project.

contact.cta: Have a project in mind? Let's talk! I'm here to understand your needs and find the sound and music solutions that work best for you.
